systems.country_label: WAPIS, installed in the national Data Collection and Registration Centre (DACORE)
systems.platform: WAPIS, implemented by INTERPOL with ECOWAS, funded by the European Union
systems.owner: INTERPOL as implementer; Mali's interior ministry attended the launch
systems.tiers: National DACORE inaugurated in Bamako in September 2015; no stations named

systems.platform: INTERPOL secure global police communications system
systems.tiers: Each DACORE is to be connected to it

note: No fact: the release says WAPIS was launched in Mali in September 2015 inside a DACORE in Bamako, to centralise police information from national law enforcement agencies and to convert existing paper police data to digital alongside new police data; it does not say stations enter reports or cases in it, so the system is not classed as record.
